subject: Startups
title: Hotmail's Signature Hack
description: A quick, practical guide to Hotmail's Signature Hack.

hook.text: In 1996, Hotmail added six words to every email: 'Get your free email at Hotmail.' It changed marketing forever.

buildup.text: Every email users sent became an ad. Recipients saw the link, clicked it, and signed up. Each user recruited more.

discovery.text: Hotmail grew from zero to 12 million users in 18 months. Microsoft bought it for $400 million.

twist.text: The genius was zero cost. No ad budget needed. The product spread itself through normal user behavior.

climax.text: This was arguably the first viral loop in tech. It proved that products can be their own distribution channel.

punchline.text: Six words, twelve million users, no ad spend.

quiz.question: How many users did Hotmail reach in 18 months?
